common.name: Name
common.setInYourHyprland: Set in your own Hyprland config.
about.channelNote: %1 takes updates before they reach stable
apps.aNameOrTheAddress: A name, or the address of an image to fetch.
apps.appliesToEveryWindowThis: Applies to every window this application opens.
apps.deleteNote: Deletes the launcher and its icon. Nothing else is removed.
apps.giveCommand: Give it a command to run.
apps.uninstallNote: Removes the package it came from, with whatever else depends on it.
apps.useTheIconFromThe: Use the icon from the site
bar.allInBar: Every widget you have is in the bar.
bar.blankSpaceAsWideAs: Blank space, as wide as you set it. Add as many as you like.
bar.disabledNote: These keep their settings and their old place until they are enabled again.
bar.backgroundNote: Glassy blurs what is behind the bar; clear lets the wallpaper show through.
bar.theWidgetTheCentreSection: The widget the centre section is anchored on.
bindings.clash: %1 already runs %2. Adding this replaces it.
bindings.clashUnnamed: %1 already runs something else. Adding this replaces it.
bindings.keysAsHyprlandSpellsThem: Keys as Hyprland spells them: SUPER, SHIFT, CTRL, ALT, and a key.
bluetooth.discoverableAs: Phones and headsets pairing from their own side see it as “%1”. Switches itself off again after a few minutes.
bluetooth.discoverableNote: Needed only when the other device is doing the pairing. Switches itself off again after a few minutes.
bluetooth.letOtherDevicesFindThis: Let other devices find this one
compose.theComposeKeyFirstThen: The compose key first, then the keys to press after it. Write the compose key as <Multi_key>.
defaults.anAppYouHaveNot: An app you have not installed yet is set up the first time you pick it.
disk.howMuchOfTheDrive: How much of the drive's rated write life is used up.
disk.nothingMounted: Nothing on this drive is mounted
disk.nothingMountedThatThisWindow: Nothing mounted that this window can see.
disk.spaceTheSystemUsesWhen: Space the system uses when memory runs short.
disk.takenBySnapperAndBy: Taken by snapper, and by Omarchy before it updates packages.
disk.workingOutWhatIsUsing: Working out what is using the space…
disk.yourHomeDirectoryTookToo: Your home directory took too long to measure, so its space is counted under System.
displays.appliedWhenBack: Applied when the display comes back.
displays.showWhatAnotherDisplayIs: Show what another display is showing.
displays.vrrNote: Lets the display follow what is being drawn instead of its own clock.
displays.wideColourAndTenBit: Wide colour and ten-bit output. Everything that is not HDR is mapped into it, which some desktops render washed out.
effects.blursTheWallpaperInsteadOf: Blurs the wallpaper instead of the windows underneath.
effects.blursWhateverIsBehindTranslucent: Blurs whatever is behind translucent windows and layers. Costs GPU.
effects.grainMixedIntoTheBlur: Grain mixed into the blur to hide banding.
effects.haloAroundTheFocusedWindow: Halo around the focused window. Its colour is a separate Hyprland option this page leaves alone.
effects.howMuchVibrancyAppliesTo: How much vibrancy applies to dark areas.
effects.howSharplyTheGlowFades: How sharply the glow fades out.
effects.howSharplyTheShadowFades: How sharply the shadow fades out.
effects.morePassesIsSmootherAnd: More passes is smoother and slower. 3 is a good ceiling.
effects.saturationBoostForTheBlurred: Saturation boost for the blurred image.
effects.sizeOfTheShadowRelative: Size of the shadow relative to the window.
font.scalesTheShellGtkApps: Scales the shell, GTK apps, and terminals together.
groups.drawsWindowTitlesInThe: Draws window titles in the tabs.
groups.hidesTheStripWhenThe: Hides the strip when the group has one window.
groups.showsTheTabStripOn: Shows the tab strip on grouped windows.
herdr.everyPrefixShortcutStartsWith: Every prefix+… shortcut starts with this.
herdr.hideTheTabBarWith: Hide the tab bar with one tab
herdr.offGivesTmuxStyleSplitters: Off gives tmux-style splitters with no frame around the edge.
herdr.offLetsTheTerminalHandle: Off lets the terminal handle clicks, so links stay clickable.
herdr.openConfigTomlForThe: Open config.toml for the settings this page does not cover.
herdr.playedWhenAnAgentChanges: Played when an agent changes state in a background workspace.
herdr.shownWhenAPaneHas: Shown when a pane has no name of its own.
herdr.takesEffectTheNextTime: Takes effect the next time Herdr launches.
herdr.theFullListAsHerdr: The full list, as Herdr has it.
herdr.title: Title
idle.unlockAnimationNote: Shown while the machine starts up and while it unlocks.
keyboard.addSeveralLayoutsSeparatedBy: Add several layouts separated by commas, then set a shortcut to switch under Options.
keyboard.giveASingleKeyboardIts: Give a single keyboard its own settings, apart from the ones above.
layout.above10FavoursSplitting: Above 1.0 favours splitting side by side.
layout.fractionOfTheScreenOne: Fraction of the screen one column takes. 97% shows one at a time.
layout.fractionOfTheScreenThe: Fraction of the screen the master window takes.
layout.keepsTheSplitDirectionWhen: Keeps the split direction when a window closes.
layout.letsALoneColumnUse: Lets a lone column use the whole screen.
layout.picksTheSplitDirectionFrom: Picks the split direction from where in the window you drop.
layout.scrollingGivesYouNiriStyle: Scrolling gives you niri-style side-scrolling columns.
layout.sizeOfANewSplit: Size of a new split relative to its sibling.
layout.whereANewlyOpenedWindow: Where a newly opened window goes.
layout.whichEdgeTheMasterWindow: Which edge the master window occupies.
migrate.note: Until they do, this window cannot mark them as changed or put back what they replaced. It may close for a moment while they move.
migrate.title: Your settings from OmaSettings have not come across
network.channelBusy: Channel busy — pages may stall: %1 % of frames were retried even though the signal is strong. Something else is using channel %2.
network.resolvedLocallyBeforeDnsAn: Resolved locally, before DNS. An entry here overrides what any DNS server returns.
nvim.aColumnNumberOrEmpty: A column number, or empty for none.
nvim.changesHereApplyTheNext: Changes here apply the next time Neovim starts.
nvim.openOptionsLuaForAnything: Open options.lua for anything this page does not cover.
nvim.whereGitMarksAndDiagnostics: Where git marks and diagnostics appear.
omaControl.addToBar: Add OmaControl to the bar to use these.
omaControl.countsNightLightDoNot: Counts Night light, Do not disturb and Stay awake on the gear.
omaControl.marksTheGearWhenThe: Marks the gear when the laptop or a Bluetooth device is at 10 % or under. A click then opens Power or Bluetooth.
omaControl.marksTheGearWhenThere: Marks the gear when there is no network at all. A click then opens Network.
overview.chargeIt: Charge it before it drops off Bluetooth.
overview.kernelMayNotFit: A kernel update may not fit.
overview.mirrorsNotChecked: Mirrors have not been checked yet.
overview.waitingInTheRepositoriesAnd: Waiting in the repositories and the AUR.
packages.anUpdateIsWaitingFor: An update is waiting for this one
packages.lastReplaced: When a package was last replaced
packages.mirrorsNotChecked: Mirrors have not been checked yet — nothing here is known to be current.
packages.neededByNothing: Nothing — it can be removed on its own
packages.noneByName: No package here by that name.
packages.openOneToSeeWhat: Open one to see what it is and what would go with it.
packages.pickNote: Search the ones you chose by name, with each one's details beside it. What you pick there is removed without asking again.
packages.removeNote: Removes it and anything that came in only for it. The terminal lists them and asks.
packages.removeRefused: Other packages need this one, so pacman will refuse until they go first.
packages.showingFirst: Showing the first %1 of %2 — type a name to reach the rest.
packages.toDownloadPlusBuilt: %1 to download, plus what is built
plugins.aPluginIsCodeRunning: A plugin is code running inside your shell
plugins.addedOff: Added %1. It stays off until you switch it on.
plugins.addedOffUnnamed: Added it. It stays off until you switch it on.
plugins.addedOnUnnamed: Added it and switched it on.
plugins.addingOneReloadsTheShell: Adding one reloads the shell's plugins, so this window closes for a moment and comes back with the result.
plugins.addressHasPassword: Not checked: its address holds a password
plugins.author: Author
plugins.contestedNote: More than one copy here claims this id and only one of them runs, so neither can be matched to the plugins.omarchy.org listing.
plugins.deletesThePluginAndIts: Deletes the plugin and its checkout. Omarchy lists what goes and asks in a terminal.
plugins.elsewhereNote: plugins.omarchy.org lists this id from a different repository than the one this copy was cloned from.
plugins.elsewhereReviewedNote: plugins.omarchy.org lists this id from a different repository than the one this copy was cloned from, so its review is of that code, not this.
plugins.filesDiffer: Files here differ from commit %1, the one plugins.omarchy.org verified.
plugins.filesUnread: Its files could not be read in time to compare them with commit %1, the one plugins.omarchy.org verified.
plugins.gitUrlNoSpaces: A git URL cannot contain spaces.
plugins.itsLastCheckOfThis: Its last check of this plugin failed against the current Omarchy. It may still run here; it is no longer offered to anyone else.
plugins.listingNoRepoNote: The plugins.omarchy.org listing under this id does not name its repository, so this copy cannot be matched to it.
plugins.noOriginNote: This copy does not say where it was cloned from, so it cannot be matched to the plugins.omarchy.org listing under the same id.
plugins.noPasswordInUrl: Leave the password out of the address. While it downloads, anyone on this computer could read it.
plugins.notASandboxAndNot: Not a sandbox and not a separate process: it runs in the one that draws your bar, with everything you can reach. Add repositories you trust, and read a plugin before switching it on.
plugins.offNote: Off leaves it installed and loads none of it.
plugins.required: The shell will not start without this one.
plugins.switchItOnOnceIt: Switch it on once it is added
plugins.theMarketplaceCouldNotGet: The marketplace could not get this one working
plugins.thisCopyIsNotThe: This copy is not the one that was reviewed
plugins.unlistedNote: It is not on plugins.omarchy.org, which is expected for one of your own or one installed straight from a git URL.
plugins.verifiedNoCommit: plugins.omarchy.org verified commit %1, and this copy is at no commit.
plugins.verifiedOtherCommit: plugins.omarchy.org verified commit %1, and this copy is at %2.
plugins.windowCloses: The window closes for a moment while the shell reloads.
pointer.giveASingleMouseOr: Give a single mouse or touchpad its own settings, apart from the ones above.
pointer.howFarThePointerTravels: How far the pointer travels for the same hand movement.
pointer.offUsesTheLowerRight: Off uses the lower-right corner instead.
power.capacityIsWhatTheBattery: Capacity is what the battery holds today. Rated capacity is what the manufacturer specified, usually lower than the actual capacity.
processes.loadNote: Tasks waiting for the processor over 1, 5 and 15 min.
security.dockerOpen: Ports Docker publishes for its containers are open to the network whatever is listed here.
security.everyoneCanReach: Every program listening on the network can be reached by anyone on it.
security.fido2Off: Not set up · a touch of a key can approve admin prompts
security.fido2On: Set up · a touch of the key approves admin prompts
security.fingerprintOff: Not set up · the reader here can unlock the screen and approve admin prompts
security.fingerprintOn: Set up · unlocks the screen and approves admin prompts
security.letsAllIn: Anything a rule below does not turn away is let in.
security.rulesNeedPassword: Its rules can only be read with an administrator's password.
security.rulesUnreadable: The firewall's rules could not be read.
security.sshKeysOnly: On · accepts sign-ins from authorized keys only
security.sshOff: Off · lets another computer sign in to this one with a key you authorize, and opens its port
security.sshOn: On · accepts sign-ins from other computers
security.sshPasswords: On · accepts a password as well as a key
tmux.clickToFocusAPane: Click to focus a pane, drag to resize, scroll to page back.
tmux.lowValuesKeepEscSnappy: Low values keep Esc snappy in Vim; zero can break some terminals.
tmux.openTmuxConfForBindings: Open tmux.conf for bindings, styling, and plugins.
tmux.theFullListAsTmux: The full list, as tmux has it.
tmux.whetherTmuxHandsCopiedText: Whether tmux hands copied text to the outer terminal.
ui.appRules.floatingOpensAFreeWindow: Floating opens a free window rather than one tiled into the layout.
ui.appRules.noDimmingOrLockingWhile: No dimming or locking while a window of this application is open.
ui.appRules.opensInTheMiddleOf: Opens in the middle of the screen.
ui.appRules.percentOfTheScreenLeave: Percent of the screen. Leave empty to let the application decide.
ui.appRules.sendTheWindowToIts: Send the window to its workspace without switching to it.
ui.appRules.showsAsABlackRectangle: Shows as a black rectangle to anyone you share your screen with.
ui.appRules.staysOnScreenWhicheverWorksp: Stays on screen whichever workspace you switch to.
ui.appRules.theWindowAppearsWithoutPulli: The window appears without pulling you away from what you were doing.
usage.nothingOnThisMachineCollects: Nothing on this machine collects it. Omarchy ships collectors for Claude Code, Codex and Fireworks.
window.nothingHereForWhatYou: Nothing here for what you typed.
window.resetAllQuestion: Reset all %1 settings changed from this window?
window.resetOne: Reset the one setting changed from this window?
windows.20IsACircle: 2.0 is a circle; higher gets you a squircle.
windows.aMultiplierOverTheAnimation: A multiplier over the animation set Omarchy ships. Higher is faster.
windows.countsTheBorderAsPart: Counts the border as part of the window rather than drawing it outside.
windows.darkensAWindowWhileOne: Darkens a window while one of its dialogs is open.
windows.dimmingAppliedBehindASpecial: Dimming applied behind a special workspace.
windows.dimmingBehindWindowsUsingThe: Dimming behind windows using the dimaround window rule.
windows.extraSpaceBetweenWorkspacesWhile: Extra space between workspaces while they slide past.
windows.gapAroundFloatingWindows0: Gap around floating windows. 0 follows the inner gap.
windows.howCloseAFloatingWindow: How close a floating window gets before it snaps to another.
windows.howCloseAFloatingWindow2: How close a floating window gets before it snaps to a screen edge.
windows.omarchyFadesEveryWindowTo: Omarchy fades every window to 98.5%, which multiplies with the settings below. This clears it, so 100% is 100%.
windows.opacityWhileAWindowIs: Opacity while a window is fullscreen.
windows.openLooknfeelLuaForAnything: Open looknfeel.lua for anything this page does not cover.
windows.slidesTheShortWayWhen: Slides the short way when moving between the first and last workspace.
windows.snapFloatingWindowsToEach: Snap floating windows to each other and to screen edges.
workspaces.itsDisplayNameLayoutAnd: Its display, name, layout, and whether it stays when empty.
workspaces.noRules: No application is bound to a workspace yet.

workspaces.rulesCount.one: One application opens somewhere of its own.
workspaces.rulesCount.other: %1 applications open somewhere of their own.

workspaces.shownInTheBarInstead: Shown in the bar instead of the number.
workspaces.staysInTheBarWith: Stays in the bar with no windows on it.
workspaces.theWorkspaceADisplayShows: The workspace a display shows when it is plugged in.
workspaces.whichWorkspaceAnApplicationOp: Which workspace an application opens on, how it shows, and whether it starts at login.
workspaces.windowsEdgeToEdgeWith: Windows edge to edge with no borders, rounding or decorations.
